title: Getz's pregnant wife begs Sam to return
summary: After Sam quits, Getz sends his wife to beg him to stay and then calls from South America.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: So I said, 'man, we--we going on back home.' So me and Jimmy came on back home. And Stan Getz's wife was pregnant with one of his kids.

So after I quit, she'd come to my house. She was pregnant. And she came to my house, man, crying. Begging me to please--he had sent her or made her come begging me to please stay in the band. And I told her--I told this lady, said 'you know.' I mean she was crying, man, tearfully, man. Cause he had made her, man, come way out in Long Island to my house into the city, man.

And uh, and say that he would--he would go--he would go and get himself together. And he left and went to down somewhere in South America, stay in the sun. And calling me up. Oh, man, he would call me up, man. I was--every time he called me, I would hang up on him, you know.
